<!-- r1-handoff-20261008 -->
## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-10-08

Execution is stopped at the user's request. All workers are settled; active R1 runtime, SSH and fetch commands joined; Linux111's R1 reservation is genuinely released. **Resume from the [durable handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md)**, then refresh live heads, dependencies, reviews/CI and host ownership. The guide contains exact source branches, failures, source-only acceptance, unexecuted checks, preserved evidence and the restart order. Earlier checkpoint status below is historical. No product or performance acceptance is implied, and this ticket remains open.

**This node:** the full public population/concurrency/churn qualification harness remains unlanded. H0 #5101/#5102 is merged, but runtime predecessors remain unmet. #5094 is activated, so consume its final gate along with #5092/#5093/#5095 and all selected #5113/S/P obligations. First land a reviewed fail-closed harness/schema with exact provenance and required oracles; then #5097 can collect on frozen merged product/harness. Existing diagnostic drivers are historical specimens with expired windows.

<!-- /r1-handoff-20261008 -->

## Accepted execution contract v3 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is10000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. The prior1000-read blocks remain retained and unaccepted; longer-exposure/key-coverage decision: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6039866047. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal and primary output

Land one reviewed public qualification harness/schema before expensive final collection for [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Primary deliverable: **PR** after accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) and merged [#5092](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5092)/[#5093](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5093)/[#5095](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5095), plus [#5094](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5094) only if activated. Each runtime PR still owns its focused before/after evidence; this harness owns shared final population/concurrency/churn protocol, not runtime optimization.

Reuse current R1 public fixtures/capture/source-binding/validators and native Quicksilver profile primitives where semantics match. Preserve #5056 original packets/15% classifications and accepted failed/noisy history; new routes/metrics have their own versioned protocol. #5030 and COW/MVCC qualification retain their engine gates.

## Required public workload and accounting

- Baseline/candidate complete Get/GetInto, ordinary/prepared batch and bounded index range; cold, first-use and warmed setup separately, including caller-owned output costs.
- Equivalent generic/native bio/email/city mutations with one/32-row requests, narrow/wide fields, indexes/no indexes, no-ops/conflicts, and complete durable ACK. Record exclusive phases and nested subphases without double-counting; report actual physical sync and queue/prepare/publication work.
- Targeted population/asset/revision ladders and concurrency frozen by [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091). Exercise supported public cached and direct backend routes separately; do not compare hidden-route costs as equivalent.
- Churn across a representative population, not only 512 repeated hot IDs. Include pinned reader then release, segment rollover, checkpoint/rewrite selection/GC completion and final reopen, with current and historical postings/full-row oracles.
- Attribute complete durable storage excluding redo WAL, logical live bytes, append-active/retired/protected/replay/allocator debt, manifest inventory/deletion work and actual path absence. Count failed/deferred work honestly.
- Process Go allocations/objects plus DB-owned retention and peak/live heap/RSS where feasible, with fixture/oracle memory separated. Typed unavailable dimensions fail or remain explicitly unavailable; SQLite C allocation is not silently counted as zero.

## Test-first exception, validator and freeze gates

Instrumentation/harness changes are **performance-sensitive**; there is no meaningful red runtime speedup test. Start with rejection tests for phase overlap, mismatched rows/ownership/durability, insufficient work/population, private helper paths, missing/noisy/relabelled cells, unsupported rollover claims, stale source/binary/runtime/CGO identity, discarded failures and missing memory/storage axes. Include a small public rehearsal that is explicitly nonqualifying.

- [ ] Protocol fixes timer boundaries, fixture/size/concurrency, repetitions/interleaving/noise, quantitative [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) objectives and honest per-gate unavailable/failure behavior before candidates.
- [ ] Real public dispatch/counters, complete oracles and enabled instrumentation overhead are reviewed.
- [ ] Fail-closed validator and deliberately corrupted source/semantic artifact tests pass.
- [ ] Product and harness/schema runtime files/blobs, effective toolchain/CGO/environment, original binaries and dependencies can be independently frozen/restored; working bytes are checked as well as Git SHAs.
- [ ] Required docs/producers/parsers/artifact tests match any changed profiling names. Dedicated Go test profiles remain distinct from benchprof inputs.
- [ ] Reviewed PR merges before [#5097](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5097) expensive collection; root records exact freeze and verifies runner/cache/storage availability.

Docs: versioned R1 architecture qualification spec/runbook and evidence README, typed-storage-performance, both profiling READMEs and artifact consumers when changed. No final acceptance from a rehearsal or current-only timings.

Parent execution policy applies: isolated topic PR, mature reviews, strict current-head TreeDB required gate, source/owner refresh and no unsolicited CI cancellation.


## Required constructor gate — 2026-10-08

The activated runtime gates now include [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), which owns genuine constructor-time Pager/resident accounting, strict shared-loan admission and actual read/index/stable-token terminal lifetime. Consume its merged accepted exact source through #5093/#5094/#5108/#5095. Component normal/race checks and source-only packets do not satisfy whole finite-budget, platform, durability, default-rollover or public performance acceptance. The original quantitative gates remain unchanged.
title: [R1 architecture] Land public scale and churn qualification with causal cost accounting
